items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Freddie Greene which you say is an annexation of Cliff McTighe and Walter Page the fourth. Count Basie, Walter Page, Jo Jones, and Freddie Greene.

ctx.x: I didn't find out until I went out with Joe Bushkin what I knew about Fess. I've been there, you see. Because I was a kid, I was a kid that just wanted to be around you.

You're just amazing. Just a minute, Jo, I want to get back to something else. I want to ask you - it turns out as time will show and has shown as of 1973, in all the annals of band playing dance music, there's only been one superlative rhythm section, one that was impeccable, that is held in esteem by every jazz musician in the world and every jazz listener, everyone that appreciates jazz, and that was the great rhythm section which you headed in the Count Basie band. That is with you, Jo Jones, on drums; Walter…
